territories.name: Malawi
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Malawi levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act (Chapter 42:02): section 7 imposes it on supplies made in Malawi, on imports and on imported services, section 9 sets the rate (raised from 16.5 to 17.5 per cent from 30 December 2025 by the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Act, 2025), section 21 and the Second Schedule zero-rate exports, and section 34 has the taxable person file the return by the 25th of the month following.
